_comment: Per-scene adherence beats for bench/results/2026-09-26 big run; drafted from each prompt's text; a viewer marks each yes/no/partly.

beats.beat: Live-action photographic look, not animated or painted
One continuous shot; no cut anywhere in the clip
Exactly two people: a customer in a grey raincoat and a cook in a white apron; no extra or cloned people
A red neon sign reading "老张牛肉面" hangs above the serving hatch, legible and correctly written
Customer is on the street side of the counter; cook is behind the steaming stockpot
The camera zooms out slowly, widening from the sign to the whole counter
The customer holds up two fingers toward the cook
The customer, not the cook, says "两碗牛肉面，一碗不要辣。" in Chinese
The cook nods once and lifts a ladle, and never speaks
A small radio behind the counter is heard playing a thin, tinny pop song
No music other than the radio; stockpot simmer and street traffic audible
Watercolor look: soft painted edges, visible paper grain, bleeding colour
One continuous shot; no cut anywhere in the clip
The camera stays static for the whole clip
No person is visible; the only animal is one tabby cat, not duplicated
A card inside the window reads "CLOSED FOR STOCKTAKING" in black capitals on cream board
Brass letter slot at the left of frame, stone step below the window
Snow falls throughout and lies on the window rail and the step
The cat sits on the inner sill, behind the glass, not outside
The cat blinks and folds its paws
Exactly one envelope is pushed out through the letter slot from inside and lands face down on the step
The cat makes no sound; no voices at all
The slot flap and the envelope landing are heard
Soft celesta notes with a low sustained string play as score
Live-action photographic look, not animated
One runner only; the woman who shouts is heard but never seen
Shot 1 is first-person POV: gloved hands pump at the bottom of frame
The POV shakes strongly with each stride
Running across a gravel rooftop toward a low brick parapet, with the lit windows of the next building beyond
An off-screen woman's voice shouts "Left, go left!"; the runner does not say it
After the shout, the POV swings toward the left corner of the parapet
The clip cuts to a wide shot from the neighbouring roof
The runner is now seen on-screen in a dark hooded jacket and gloves, one person
The runner plants a foot on the parapet, vaults the gap, and lands on the near roof
The runner skids to a crouch with both hands down
The camera pulls out fast and wide during the vault
The runner speaks no words; only hard panting is heard
A fast drum-and-synth score that ends on a single hit at the landing
Vintage 16mm film look: grain, warm faded colour, halation around lights
One continuous shot; no cut anywhere in the clip
Exactly two people: an older woman cashier behind the glass and a teenage boy customer at the window
A red-lettered board above the window reads "TONIGHT ONLY 7:30"
The camera tilts down slowly from the lettered board to the coin dish
The cashier taps the glass and says "Seven thirty, nothing after."
The customer slides a folded note and two coins into the brass dish
The customer answers "Two, back row."
The cashier, not the customer, says "Back row is gone, love."
The cashier tears two tickets from the roll and pushes them across
The three lines come in order, one speaker at a time, with no overlap
No music; coins ring in the dish and tickets tear
Live-action photographic look, not animated
Shot 1 shows three actors at microphones plus one foley artist; no extra or cloned people
A red "ON AIR" sign on a white panel is lit above the door, top left of frame
The foley artist in a grey cardigan carries a pair of leather shoes from the door to the foley table at the left and sets them on gravel
The camera tracks slowly with the foley artist
The older actor in a waistcoat at the first microphone says "Someone is on the stairs."
The actress in a green scarf at the second microphone answers "Then put out the lamp."
The foley artist never speaks; she walks the shoes across the gravel and the steps are heard
The clip cuts to a close shot of a third actor, a young man in headphones
The camera stays static in shot 2
A white sans-serif subtitle in the lower third reads "I can hear him breathing."
The subtitle appears once, not doubled or garbled
The young man in headphones, not another actor, whispers "I can hear him breathing."
A low sustained double-bass note with a plucked figure entering around the cut
Documentary live-action look, not stylised
Exactly two crew: an older woman supervisor in hi-vis vest and wide-brimmed hat, and a younger man in the same vest; no others
A two-lane desert highway with a yellow road roller parked at the edge of fresh asphalt
Supervisor stands at the centre line with a clipboard; the younger man kneels at a seam on the right of frame
The camera pushes in slowly along the centre line toward them
The clip cuts to a medium shot of the pair at the seam, roller drum at the left edge
The supervisor, not the younger man, taps the clipboard on her thigh and says "Give it another pass before the sun drops."
The clip cuts to a low close shot of the roller's drum against the seam
The supervisor's line is not chopped or restarted by the cut
The camera stays static on the drum
The roller stays parked; nobody drives it
The younger man leans into frame above the drum and says "Two more and it's flat."
No music; an idling diesel engine and wind are heard
Vintage slapstick comedy look: exaggerated physical comedy, period costume and props
Two moving men in bowler hats and dungarees plus one bystander with a tiny poodle at the top landing; no extra or cloned people
A painted enamel street sign reads "HIGH STREET STAIRS"
The two men carry an upright piano down narrow outdoor steps, the lead mover at the lower end
The lead mover at the lower end looks up and yelps "Hold the handbrake rope, Barnaby, it's slipping through my fingers!"
The camera pedestals down slowly following the piano
The clip cuts to a medium shot of the heavyset partner at the top of the stairs
The rope in the partner's hands snaps in two with a puff of dust
The partner, not the lead mover, mutters "Well, look on the bright side, it's much lighter now."
The camera zooms in fast on the partner's face
The clip cuts to a wide shot from the bottom of the stairs
The lead mover dives onto the banister and the piano slides down the steps and crashes into a fruit cart, sending oranges flying
Both movers slide down the banister rails after the piano
The camera stays static in shot 3
Modern music-video look in a minimalist studio with ice-blue lighting and a matte black back wall
One woman lead vocalist and exactly four backup dancers; no extra or cloned people
An illuminated wall graphic reads "STUDIO ZERO"
The four backup dancers hold a freeze pose in a row at the back left corner while the vocalist dances at a standing microphone
The camera pans right fast across the dance line
The vocalist sings the Korean line "심장이 뛰는 소리를 들어봐."
Only the vocalist sings; the backup dancers never sing or speak
The clip cuts to a tight low-angle medium close shot of the vocalist with white and violet LED bars strobing behind
The vocalist sings "Never stop the beat, light up the night!" in English
The camera pushes in fast toward her eyes
The clip cuts to a wide centre-stage shot
The singer and four backup dancers (four, not more or fewer) drop into a floor spin together
The camera pulls out slowly, then holds static as the performers freeze in a silhouette formation
A fast electronic dance track with heavy bass plays as score
Black-and-white 1950s courtroom look
A robed judge, a prosecutor in a three-piece suit, and a defendant who is a different man; no cloned principals
A carved oak seal reading "JUSTICE UNDER LAW" sits behind the bench
The judge sits motionless with folded hands and never speaks
The prosecutor strides along the jury rail holding a gold pocket watch
The prosecutor, turning to the witness stand, says "Did you or did you not sign the transfer deed at midnight?"
The camera pushes in slowly toward the witness box
The clip cuts to a close medium shot of the defendant gripping the brass rail of the witness stand
The defendant, not the prosecutor, says "That signature was forged before I even reached the docks."
The camera stays static on the defendant
The clip cuts to a high-angle shot looking down over the bench across the courtroom
The prosecutor sets the pocket watch down on the defense table
The camera trucks right slowly, bringing the spectator benches into frame
A slow, brooding string score under the scene
Live-action period drama in a misty bamboo grove
Exactly two warriors: a ronin in a grey kimono and straw sandals, and a rival in dark armour and a lacquered straw hat; no others
A wooden trail marker stands beside the path with "関ヶ原街道" carved in vertical kanji
The two stand far apart across the clearing, the ronin's hand on his sheathed katana
The ronin, not the rival, says "この道を行くなら、剣を抜け。" in Japanese; the rival does not answer
The camera pedestals down slowly to the ronin's scabbard
The clip cuts to a chest-up close shot of the rival, his gloved fingers thumbing the tsuba, loosening the blade
The rival says "我が刃はお前の首を望んでいる。" in Japanese
The camera zooms in fast on the blade edge
The clip cuts to a wide profile shot of both warriors sprinting toward each other
Their blades cut through exactly three bamboo stalks, which topple
The duelists pass each other and freeze back-to-back with drawn swords
The camera stays static in shot 3
Sparse taiko and shakuhachi score; a blade click is heard in shot 2
Silent-era black-and-white look: heavy grain, vignetted corners, exposure flicker
No voices and no sound effects anywhere in the clip
A solo piano plays throughout and fades out on the final frame
One young woman in a high-collared blouse sits at a lace-curtained window holding an open letter
The camera stays static in shot 1
She reads, lifts her eyes to the window, mouths words silently, and presses the letter to her chest
The clip changes to a black intertitle card filling the frame
The card reads "SHE NEVER WROTE BACK." in centred white serif capitals inside a thin white ornamental border
The card is held static
A fade to black, then a wide shot of a railway platform under a glass canopy
One man in a long overcoat and bowler hat beside a leather case; no other people
The camera pans left slowly, following him
He picks up the case and walks off, turns once toward the camera and mouths silent words with his hat held to his chest
He puts the hat back on and walks into the steam until only his silhouette remains
Live-action photographic look, not animated
Exactly two people in the whole station: the suspect in a grey hooded windbreaker and the agent in a black leather jacket; no bystanders, no clones
An illuminated overhead sign reads "DOWNTOWN PLATFORM"
The suspect vaults the turnstile first and the agent vaults the same turnstile behind him: the agent chases the suspect, not the reverse
The suspect runs toward a concrete stairwell that leads down
A fast tracking shot alongside the agent, with strong shake
The clip cuts to a medium close shot of the agent alone on the stairwell landing, the suspect out of frame
The agent, not the suspect, touches his earpiece and says "Suspect is heading down to the lower tracks!"
The camera pushes in fast and large toward the agent's face
The agent runs on down the stairs, not up
The clip cuts to a wide low-angle shot from the platform floor looking up the stairwell, yellow strobes pulsing
The suspect lands on the platform first; the agent jumps down behind him, tackles him, and ends pinning him on the floor
The camera stays static in shot 3
Only one voice speaks, the agent's; the suspect makes no vocal sound

On the crossing, only the elderly man and the tortoise; one bus driver visible behind the windscreen; no other pedestrians
A zebra crossing on a quiet city street, overcast morning
The man, in his seventies, wears a green knitted cardigan and a brown flat cap
He holds a red leather leash in his RIGHT hand, clipped to a harness on a large grey tortoise

A red double-decker bus waits at the stop line on the right of frame, its driver watching
